title: Zhou Ru Is Born
summary: Wang Lin places Li Muwan's Nascent Soul in a newborn girl, Zhou Ru, born to shopkeeper Zhou in Xinghua Village, knowing it will take about eighteen years for Wan'er to recover her memories, and that Heaven's Law will come again then. A year later a Suzaku Country envoy orders Zeng Niu to fight Hongdie within three months, and Wang Lin pushes it back to ten years. Sun Dian and Zi Xin invite him into the Land of the Forsaken Immortals to find the Reincarnation Tree, whose fruit raises the chance of breaking through from Soul Formation to Soul Transformation by thirty percent. From Tu Si's memories Wang Lin knows the fruit can also complete the Body Cleansing that would make him a true Ancient God. Meanwhile Hongdie refuses a limb-regrowing East Sea spirit and finds his curse on her arm. Wang Lin gives Tie Yan a technique, binds the demon Xu Liguo into the Rain Celestial Sword as its spirit, and enters the Forsaken land, where rune puppets and a three-leaf curse master attack.
